Name: Skull Cavern Floor Capping
Author: SummerFleur
Description:
Add a new rule to prevent the treasure rooms in Skull Cavern level 200 and 300 to be skipped when entering a mine shaft.

For example, if you jumped in a shaft in Skull Cavern level 199, and this mod will ensure you floored in level 200 instead of skip it.

[b][color=#12ff31]For the best experience, I highly recommend using it with mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37452]Why Not Jump In That Mine Shaft[/url].[/color][/b]

[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]

Incompatible mods are not clear temporarily, if you find an incompatible mod, please report at [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿,

[b][size=4]Install[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=4]Found a bug?[/size][/b]

Please submit bugs on the [url=https://github.com/SummerFleur2997/StardewMods/issues]Github issue tracker[/url]﻿, please avoid leave comments at nexus because I don't check it often.

[b][size=4]Thanks to...[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url] for [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI]SMAPI[/url]
[/list]


添加了新的游戏机制，妈妈再也不用担心跳入竖井时跳过骷髅洞穴 200 层和 300 层的宝藏房间了。

例如，在 199 层跳入竖井时，本模组会确保你在第 200 层落地，而不是直接跳过 200 层。

[b][color=#12ff31]强烈建议配合模组 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37452]Why Not Jump In That Mine Shaft[/url] 食用！！[/color][/b]
